$reason: The strip with a fallback list, `role="tablist<TAB>list"` — a tab between the two tokens. The three engines take the first token that names a role, on any whitespace, so it is a `tablist`; axe's own reader takes the value whole unless asked for its fallback, and even then splits on a space alone, and reads no role at all. The gate takes the engines' side, because the question is what the reader announces.
